From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Subject: POC kickoff & model shortlist for BioHeal clinical triage

Hi Elena / Marcus —

Thanks for the call today. Quick recap and proposed plan so we have a single source of truth before we kick off the technical work: 

Summary of needs (from discovery)
- Primary use: clinical triage assistant for patient intake (symptom classification + red-flag escalation)
- Languages: en-US, es-ES (Spanish), fr-FR (French) — high priority for en/ES, secondary for FR
- Data: sample anonymized chat logs (~3k utterances) and a small set of annotated red-flag examples (~200) will be shared by BioHeal
- Constraints: latency-sensitive (interactive triage), high precision on red-flag recall, privacy controls required (PII handling / audit logs)

Proposed POC scope (30-day):
1) Ingest sample dataset and run baseline evaluation across 2 open-model variants
2) Compare: Mistral-7B-instruct (primary candidate) vs Falcon-40B-instruct (high-accuracy secondary)
3) Fallback: Quantized Mistral-7B (mistral-7b-q4) for low-cost bursts; ephemeral KV cache warmup for common prefixes
4) Multilingual approach: single multilingual prompt + language-specific evaluation slices; we will test deterministic translation fallback only if model performance drops below threshold

Success criteria (proposed acceptance):
- Intent classification top-1 accuracy >= 92% on held-out test set
- Red-flag recall >= 95% (high weight)
- NER / slot F1 >= 0.88 for key clinical entities
- p95 latency <= 350 ms for 512-token context (hosted)
- Token cost goal: < $0.002 per 1k tokens (baseline economics target)
- Manual QA: average evaluator rating >= 4.0 / 5 on 200 sampled conversations

Owners and immediate next steps:
- Ben Carter (me): kickoff, HubSpot updates, orchestrate infra with Rishi, point-of-contact for schedule
- Marissa Cole: evaluation matrix, metrics dashboard, runbook for human evaluation (deliverable: eval matrix XLSX)
- Rishi Malhotra: infra sizing, Dedicated vs Hosted cost estimates, privacy / VPC checklist
- BioHeal: deliver anonymized sample dataset and security contact (SOC2 evidence request) by EOM

Tentative timeline:
- 2026-09-22: POC kickoff meeting (30–45m)
- 2026-09-25: BioHeal sample data ingestion complete
- 2026-09-30: Baseline runs (Mistral-7B-instruct + Falcon-40B-instruct)
- 2026-10-07: Evaluation readout (metrics + qualitative notes)
- 2026-10-13: Decision / next-steps meeting (expand, tune, or pilot)

Attachments I’m including: bioheal-poc-sow-draft.pdf (SOW + rough SOW timeline), bioheal-eval-matrix.xlsx (skeleton).

Questions for BioHeal:
- Are there any regulatory redlines (e.g., must run on-prem) we need to account for during POC?
- Who will own acceptance for the clinical QA (name + role)?

I’ll schedule the kickoff for 09/22 — please confirm availability.

Thanks,
Ben

Thanks Elena — great. Two quick updates before the kickoff: 

1) Security contact: adding Rishi (rishi.malhotra@redwood.com) as the security/infra lead for this thread — he’ll follow up on SOC2 artifacts and where logs will live.

2) Model specifics / rationale:
   - Primary candidate: Mistral-7B-instruct — small enough to meet latency targets while delivering strong instruction-following for triage prompts.
   - Fallback/low-cost: mistral-7b-q4 (quantized) — we’ll use as a burst fallback when cost constraints bind; expect modest drops in entity extraction, track separately in eval matrix.
   - High-accuracy backup: Falcon-40B-instruct (hosted/dedicated) — use for edge cases where red-flag precision is critical; we’ll benchmark costs vs benefit in week 2.

3) Multilingual approach:
   - We’ll run a single-model evaluation for en/es/fr slices. If Spanish performance is >6% worse than English on intent accuracy, the plan is to test a language-specific fine-tune (lightweight) or apply model routing (route Spanish to Falcon-40B as fallback).

4) Deliverables by kickoff (09/22):
   - BioHeal: SFTP link + sample data (expected 09/24 but having a link now speeds onboarding)
   - Redwood: final eval-matrix.xlsx (Marissa), baseline infra plan and cost delta (Rishi), signed SOW draft (Ben)

Marissa — can you confirm you’ll populate the evaluation slices for en/es/fr and add columns for quantized fallback performance? I linked the eval matrix in the attachments.

Rishi — if you can advise on whether Dedicated would be necessary for the Falcon-40B runs or if hosted capacity with reserved slots suffices, that’d be useful for our internal estimate.

I’ll send calendar invites for 09/22 10:00am PT.

Ben
